key.name: accent-color
key.description: A palette id from lib/colors.js, or 'custom' to use custom-color, or 'system' to leave the GNOME accent color untouched.

key.name: custom-color
key.description: Hex color used when accent-color is 'custom'.

key.name: apply-to-folders
key.description: Writes accent-tinted copies of the folder icons into ~/.local/share/icons, shadowing the system icon theme.

key.name: force-important
key.description: Marks generated shell declarations !important so they win against the base theme regardless of stylesheet cascade order.
